'''Defiant Core''' was a base established on [[Innton II]], a planet near the [[Triton system/Legends|Triton system]]. It had been built out of a previous [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base that had been made using parts salvaged parts from a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]], ''[[Nova Defiant/Legends|Nova Defiant]]'', that had crashed on the planet. The Separatists were not able to finish the construction before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and left it abandoned. Later the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] found the base largely intact after investigating rumors of its existence. The Rebels housed a squadron of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]] at the base and was under command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Romar Kek]].<ref name="SoR" />
